title: Built-in span type docs table must list every SpanType constant
answers: a new span type was added in code but is not shown in the tracing docs
which span types are documented for MLflow tracing
how do I add a new SpanType to the docs
span types missing from the span concepts page
body: Invariant: the built-in span type table in docs/docs/genai/concepts/span.mdx must list every constant defined on SpanType in mlflow/entities/span.py. The docs had drifted: WORKFLOW, TASK, GUARDRAIL and EVALUATOR existed in code but were absent from the table (PR #25736, issue #25666). Fix pattern: when adding or changing a SpanType constant, add or update the matching row in the same table, with its value in quotes and a one-line description. Enforcement: nothing in the diff or review shows a test or lint check for this parity, so it is manual. Skipping it leaves users unaware of valid span types.
applies: Applies to any change that adds, renames or removes a SpanType constant in mlflow/entities/span.py; does not cover other span-related docs pages.
says: The span concepts documentation table does not list all supported tracing span types.
New execution span categories are missing from the built-in tracing reference guide.
Update the tracing documentation table with descriptions for newly supported span categories.
Several valid span types described in release updates are missing on the website.
Add documentation rows explaining each built-in span type in the generative AI guide.
